data.name: changelog
data.value:
### Changes
- Save Slots will NOT load, if Mods folder is set to AppData
### Bug Fixes
- Fixed UI rendering on 3 screens - Fixed a bug that may have caused mods to disappear, due to save files being locked - While changing saves, instead of removing folders, the folder will be moved to "SAVE SLOTS BACKUP" folder in Amistech folder
